assembly.architecture: Alternative EMPTY structural plate. Do not draw architecture on top of dressed_room or expect pixel-identical interchangeable geometry.
assembly.dressed_room: Static architecture, shelf books, small candles, vegetation, rugs and static dressing already painted together. Not a transparent furnishings-only overlay.
assembly.master: Single generated complete painting for art direction. Not assembled from the supplied sprites and not an interactive runtime export.
assembly.layer_preview: Separate raster placements rendered from this JSON. Lighting on the new room plate is painted; existing dynamic lighting controls are not ported to this art-direction pack.
assembly.weather: Room openings are transparent, but warm room illumination is baked into the dressed plate. Changing outdoor exposure alone is not physically coherent relighting.
assembly.grouping: Study, shelf and treasure clusters are rigid single rasters; their members and chest lid are not separately movable.
assembly.coordinate_accuracy: Source UV anchors, proxies and placements are visually authored estimates. Original interactive library is preserved separately.

Small distributed amber candle pools and cool mountain view

lighting.contact_shadows: Preview-generated translucent ellipses at authored supports; no physical transport.
lighting.cup_contact: Separate tight ellipse on the saucer well before drawing cup.
lighting.specular: No physically calculated specular or normal maps; newly generated sources have painted shading.
